title: Chama bar Chasa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Shabbat 88a mentions Rabbi Avdimi bar Chama bar Chasa. Eruvin 55a has bar Dosa. Zevachim 118a has Rabbi Avdimi bar Chama, while Dikdukei Soferim reads bar Chama bar Dosa. Hyman states that a dalet and vav undoubtedly became a chet, or the reverse.

notes.text: The consulted Shabbat 88a reads Rav Avdimi bar Chama bar Chasa. Hyman prints Rabbi and expresses certainty about the letter change, without choosing its direction.
